title: List initial loading → rows, empty, unauthorized, error. Demo passes isLoading=false and fixture arrays.
blocked: Live populated list loads are covered by explicit app-load cases; empty/unauthorized/error results require isolated response states not available in this account.

title: List next page → loading spinner appended to Next label → new rows/count → previous page; preserve scroll anchor. Demo initial fixtures fit one page; create enough local items for D paging if needed.
blocked: Initial fixtures and live account lists do not fill a page. Requires enough isolated records to activate pagination; no shared backend seeding performed.

title: Refetch while list has visible rows → updated/removed rows and footer count, including selected row disappearing.
blocked: Requires concurrent backend writes/removals while subscribed; shared account is inspected read-only.

title: Move prompt asynchronous visibility consequences → confirmation → cancel; `src/console/folders/move/{prompt,confirm}.tsx`.
blocked: Requires isolated resources with conflicting inherited grants and backend-derived visibility impact; shared account moves are not submitted.

title: Table/store archive → archived menu → Restore pending → restored row; archived permanent delete → pending → removed.
blocked: Archived fixture state does not retain restore/permanent-delete actions; requires isolated backend archived material and mutation permission.

title: Create/edit/visibility/move/delete pending spinner inserted beside label → success/error/rest; failure toast appears → dismisses.
blocked: Fixture operations resolve synchronously; sustained save/error transitions require an isolated backend or deterministic response fixture.

title: Grid initial load → rows; load-more band → new virtual rows → New row affordance; deleting inspected column concurrently closes sheet.
blocked: Initial and load-more grid queries need enough backend rows beyond loaded fixture page; concurrent column removal requires isolated writes.

title: Cell/row/column write failure and version conflict → error feedback → recovery without losing viewport or focus.
blocked: Version conflicts and write failures require isolated conflicting or faulted backend writes.

title: Enum dropdown open → close; select → unset or previous choice where enum schema exists. Fixture needs schema addition first.
blocked: No enum value schema exists in demo fixtures. Schema builder intentionally cannot author enums; requires API-provisioned isolated store.

title: Unsupported schema → read-only JSON schema with explanation; archived store → read-only value; write conflict → upstream reseed → toast; subscription refetch while editing.
blocked: Unsupported/archived/upstream-conflicted schemas are absent from supplied fixtures; subscription conflicts require isolated backend writes.

title: File fetch error → download fallback; oversized text fallback; media error notice; dynamic signed URL refresh must retain cached displayed URL.
blocked: Fixture assets succeed and are small; error/oversize/signed-URL refresh states require representative fixtures or controlled endpoint responses.

title: HTML Preview ↔ Code and toolbar/dock changes; lazy CodeMirror mount; reload preview after save.
blocked: No HTML file exists in supplied demo assets or inspected account; requires isolated HTML upload.

title: Audio/video metadata loading → player, playback controls show/hide, keyboard Space play/pause; media geometry.
blocked: No audio/video media exists in supplied demo assets; requires representative isolated uploads.

title: File upload dialog open → drag/drop active → file queue → uploading → done/error; retry/remove queue entries → close; full/small/many-file lists.
blocked: Demo upload action only emits toast; live uploads would change shared account and require isolated file fixtures.

title: Tool schema warm fetch → pending icon → schema dialog; Request → Response → Request; close, including nested dialogs and focus return. Demo lacks ToolReferenceContext host.
blocked: Demo lacks ToolReferenceContext host. Requires live authorized tool with schema and nested reference host, then read-only schema request.

title: Event integration select → connected trigger choices → resource/parameter options loading → results/error → query clear; trigger scope switches and matching fields add/remove.
blocked: Current live integrations are disconnected or expired; valid connected event integration is required for resource/parameter choices.

title: Job permissions and skills async resolution update instruction pills, tool counts, scope issues and editor controls; pending submission failure → error → correction.
blocked: Demo permissions resolve synchronously. Live pending skill resolution and failed save require isolated backend state.

title: Delete impact loading sentence → counts/name-confirmation fields; concurrent deleted folder → already gone state.
blocked: Demo delete impact is synchronous; concurrent folder deletion requires isolated backend writes.

title: Usage loading skeleton stats/spinner → chart/data or empty; window refetch → replacement; usage hint undefined → amount arrival.
blocked: Demo usage is already resolved; live app usage-load cases cover available query state. Empty usage/window refresh requires account with corresponding data.

title: Account name edit → pending → saved; avatar upload/remove → pending → image/fallback; email invalid → error → corrected submit → pending/success toast.
blocked: Account is live and shared; profile/avatar/email submissions would mutate it. Password/email form is not present for current Google account.

title: Security linked-accounts pending → set-password or change-password form; password reveal on → off; invalid/valid password and confirmation errors appear/clear.
blocked: Current Google account Security screen exposes active sessions only, with no password/linked-account form.

title: Change password/request reset → pending → success/error; active sessions loading skeletons → devices; revoke other session → spinner → row removal.
blocked: Active sessions load covered by Security open; revoke/password/reset commits would mutate shared identity.

title: Save organization profile/timezone/logo → pending → success/error → resolved label; name/slug long value and restore.
blocked: Organization profile/logo/timezone writes would alter shared Vedin Labs state; draft edit/open controls are covered separately.

title: Leave/Delete organization destructive submission pending and completion. Read-only open/cancel now covered by C143-leave-open/cancel and C143-delete-open/cancel at both widths.
blocked: Real Leave/Delete controls resolve after the exact task-preview permission Origin correction. Confirming either mutates the shared organization; a disposable organization is required for pending/completion. These dialogs have no name/password validation fields.

title: Remove another member confirmation open/cancel. Current member role/actions and own Leave confirmation have executable C146 subcases at both widths.
blocked: Resolved live Members contains only the current Owner. The own actions menu exposes Leave organization; another member is needed to expose Remove member. No membership was changed.

title: Change role → spinner → label; Remove member → pending → row removal; invitation cancel → pending → row removal. Isolated local account/workspace needed.
blocked: Role/removal/invitation cancellation would mutate shared membership; requires disposable organization/member.

title: User invitations loading rows → invitations/empty; Accept/Reject pending label and avatar/organization logo arrival. Accept/Reject are mutations.
blocked: Current account has no pending organization invitations; accept/reject require disposable invitation.

title: Create/rename/delete team → pending → table row/count; Add/remove member in roster popover → count/avatar list updates; reverse where supported.
blocked: Current Teams is empty; create/rename/delete/roster mutations require an isolated organization.

title: Auto top-up switch off → on reveals amount/threshold fields → off hides; amount/threshold invalid → corrected; pending save/rejection. Real configuration commit is M and was not driven.
blocked: Unsubscribed organization has Auto top-up unavailable; requires subscribed disposable billing account. Save would mutate billing.

title: Provider Connect/Reconnect pending button text/icon → error/status; do not complete external OAuth; disconnect confirmation open → Cancel close.
blocked: Current cards expose Connect/Reconnect OAuth actions; initiating would start external authorization. No disconnect control until a valid connected provider exists.

title: Provider disconnect/reconnect callback status → card controls/counts/tool section update; isolated dev provider only.
blocked: Provider callback/disconnect changes require isolated active provider connection.

title: Integration option picker dialog/popover open → close; search → loading → options/no matches/error → query clear; selected option/chip then removal.
blocked: No active provider connection supplies integration option choices in current account.

title: Integration offer claiming → accepted/expired/error outcome; success/error toast appears → dismiss; callback loader → outcome route.
blocked: No pending integration offer URL/token exists in current account.

title: Organization onboarding welcome → website form → discovery progress → ready/error/retry; dialogs close only at allowed stages; validation issue appears/clears.
blocked: Existing Vedin Labs organization is already onboarded; welcome/discovery states require a new isolated organization.

title: Add/remove domain and timezone change → pending spinner → profile row/label; errors toast and recover.
blocked: Domain/timezone submissions would mutate shared organization profile; draft controls are measured separately.

title: Review proposed update dialog open → close; proposal sections expand → collapse; added/removed/changed field groups; Approve/Discard pending label changes are M.
blocked: Current profile is approved and has no proposed update to review; approval/discard requires isolated proposal.

title: Workstream confirm/reject/archive/reopen/restore → pending → status/action/card changes. Isolated dev workspace needed.
blocked: Workstream actions require suitable isolated live workstream and backend mutation authorization.
